# hpe_morpheus_cluster_available_nics (Data Source)



Lists the candidate physical NICs on each host in a cluster, used when assigning uplinks
to a virtual switch. NICs already consumed by an existing switch uplink are flagged with
`consumed = true`. Requires Morpheus 9.1.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_cluster_available_nics" "example" {
  cluster_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The ID of the cluster (server group) whose available NICs are returned.

### Read-Only

- `available_nics` (Attributes List) Candidate physical NICs for each host in the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--available_nics))

<a id="nestedatt--available_nics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `available_nics`

Read-Only:

- `nics` (Attributes List) The physical NICs on the host. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--available_nics--nics))
- `server_id` (Number) The ID of the host (compute server).
- `server_name` (String) The name of the host.

<a id="nestedatt--available_nics--nics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `available_nics.nics`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the NIC is active.
- `consumed` (Boolean) Whether this NIC is already consumed by an existing switch uplink.
- `mac_address` (String) The MAC address of the NIC.
- `name` (String) The NIC name (e.g. eno1).
